name: claude-mods
description: Mods for Claude Code: live panes, bands and hooks that change how a session looks and behaves

plugins.name: clean-view
plugins.description: Hides tool calls, diffs and command output while Claude works, and shows the plan as a checklist above the prompt

plugins.name: status-band
plugins.description: The Awesome Statusline layout as a band above the prompt: model, git, context, 5H/7D limits and Codex 7D

plugins.name: transcript-makeover
plugins.description: Ends every tool row with a check or a red cross and how long the call took, and every turn with a receipt: time, tools, failures, cost and share of the five-hour limit

plugins.name: tool-waterfall
plugins.description: A pane that charts the tool calls of the turn as bars along its time, like a browser's network tab; opened and closed with /waterfall

plugins.name: risky-hold
plugins.description: Holds a destructive shell command (recursive delete, git reset --hard, force push, disk or database wipe) until you say run it

plugins.name: message-times
plugins.description: Shows when each prompt you sent was sent, at the right of its row in the transcript

plugins.name: spinner
plugins.description: Draws the line that moves while Claude works as a face eating a bar of blocks, with wording of your own

plugins.name: rainbow-prompt
plugins.description: Colors the prompt box as you type: ticket ids, paths, links, rainbow words, and a red warning on anything that looks like a secret
